From 2216cf68cf56808323bff44d43083422a1c4e2f9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hui Su <suhui_kernel@163.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2021 19:24:38 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] scripts: update the comments of kallsyms support

update the comments of kallsyms support.

Fixes: af73d78bd384 ("kbuild: Remove debug info from kallsyms linking")
Signed-off-by: Hui Su <suhui_kernel@163.com>
Signed-off-by: Masahiro Yamada <masahiroy@kernel.org>

diff --git a/scripts/link-vmlinux.sh b/scripts/link-vmlinux.sh
index d74cee5c4326..a98c4f045302 100755
--- a/scripts/link-vmlinux.sh
+++ b/scripts/link-vmlinux.sh
@@ -369,14 +369,14 @@ if [ -n "${CONFIG_KALLSYMS}" ]; then
 	# kallsyms support
 	# Generate section listing all symbols and add it into vmlinux
 	# It's a three step process:
-	# 1)  Link .tmp_vmlinux1 so it has all symbols and sections,
+	# 1)  Link .tmp_vmlinux.kallsyms1 so it has all symbols and sections,
 	#     but __kallsyms is empty.
 	#     Running kallsyms on that gives us .tmp_kallsyms1.o with
 	#     the right size
-	# 2)  Link .tmp_vmlinux2 so it now has a __kallsyms section of
+	# 2)  Link .tmp_vmlinux.kallsyms2 so it now has a __kallsyms section of
 	#     the right size, but due to the added section, some
 	#     addresses have shifted.
-	#     From here, we generate a correct .tmp_kallsyms2.o
+	#     From here, we generate a correct .tmp_vmlinux.kallsyms2.o
 	# 3)  That link may have expanded the kernel image enough that
 	#     more linker branch stubs / trampolines had to be added, which
 	#     introduces new names, which further expands kallsyms. Do another
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `scripts/link-vmlinux.sh`**
   - Updated comments related to the kallsyms support to clarify the linking process.
   - Changed references from `.tmp_vmlinux1` to `.tmp_vmlinux.kallsyms1` and from `.tmp_vmlinux2` to `.tmp_vmlinux.kallsyms2` in the comments.
   - Adjusted the description of the output files generated during the linking process, specifically changing `.tmp_kallsyms2.o` to `.tmp_vmlinux.kallsyms2.o`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `scripts/link-vmlinux.sh` file are focused on improving the clarity and accuracy of the comments that describe the kallsyms linking process. The changes ensure that the comments correctly reflect the naming conventions of the temporary files used during the linking stages, which helps maintain consistency and understanding for future developers working with the kallsyms support in the kernel build process. The updates are directly related to the previous commit that removed debug info from kallsyms linking, as they aim to clarify the steps involved in the updated process.
